home.heroTitle: Pixel Art, Held to a *Realist's* Standard.
home.beatText: Every square drawn, stenciled, and placed with the same precision built over years of black-and-gray realism work — now in color, one pixel at a time.
home.piecesIntro: A growing collection of pixel art tattoos — precision-built, one at a time.
